Name: Ilucie's Spider replacement - Angry Junimos (for 1.6)
Author: IlucieYt
Description:
Arachnophobia mod.

I replaced the spiders in the dangerous mines with angry Junimos. 
The Junimos went mad after I sold my soul to JoJa. Now they are after us all for revenge...

Downloads.Description:
new:
- spider webs in the mines are now junimo-colored grass. can be toggled on/off in the mod manager menu (or in the config file)
- added update-key

may not work if you use mods that replace the grass texture-file.
